faqs.q: What is the difference between MBA and PGDM at Welingkar?
faqs.a: MBA is a degree program, while PGDM is an AICTE-approved diploma focused on practical and industry-oriented learning. Both are valued by recruiters.

faqs.q: Is work experience mandatory for full-time MBA / PGDM?
faqs.a: No. Fresh graduates and candidates with 1–3 years of experience can apply. Work experience is beneficial but not mandatory.

faqs.q: Does Welingkar offer Executive or Part-Time MBA programs?
faqs.a: Yes. Welingkar offers Executive and Part-Time PGDM programs for working professionals.
CAT, XAT, CMAT, and in some cases MAT scores are accepted.
Marketing, Finance, HR, Operations, IT / Systems, Business Analytics, and more.
